column7: parseCIDRs fixed only the bare form: an explicit IPv4-mapped trusted proxy (::ffff:1.2.3.4/32, ::ffff:10.0.0.0/8) still parsed as the IPv6 network ::/32 or ::/8, trusting ::1 to set X-Forwarded-For/X-Real-IP while the intended IPv4 proxy was not trusted. Fixed by sharing the token encoder rule (rules.NormalizeIPv4MappedCIDR): mapped /N<=32 is the IPv4 network, /33-/95 is dropped (fail closed). FuzzClientIPParsing oracle (b) now covers prefixed mapped entries. Found by review (REVIEW-4536-DEEP-1)
